events.label: Kick-off
events.purpose: Agree access to data and people
events.decision: Confirm access to system data and process owners for the requirements work?
agenda: Present the engagement approach and phases
Align on the data and people the diagnostic needs
Confirm access to system data and process owners

events.label: Check-in: requirements
events.decision: Confirm which finance and purchasing requirements go into the sign-off pack?
agenda: Present the finance and purchasing requirements draft
Discuss gaps and open items by process area
Confirm which requirements go into the sign-off pack

events.label: Requirements sign-off
events.decision: Approve the requirements and go to vendor selection?
agenda: Present the requirements and fit-gap pack
Review fit-gap of current systems against requirements
Decide whether to approve and go to vendor selection

events.label: Check-in: vendor scoring
events.decision: Which scored vendors go into the business case for the selection gate?
agenda: Present the vendor shortlist and scoring
Discuss scoring gaps between vendors
Decide which vendors go into the business case

events.label: Vendor selection
events.decision: Which ERP vendor goes forward into implementation?
agenda: Present the ERP business case and vendor scoring
Discuss business case results by vendor
Decide which vendor goes into implementation

events.label: Check-in: configuration
events.decision: Confirm the tested finance and purchasing setup as the migration baseline?
agenda: Present the tested finance and purchasing configuration
Review test results and open defects
Confirm the setup as the migration baseline

events.label: Workshop 1: pilot readiness
events.decision: Go or no-go on taking the pilot site live with the tested setup?
agenda: Review the tested inventory configuration
Review data migration rehearsal results and load checks
Decide whether the pilot site goes live

events.label: Workshop 2: rollout start
events.decision: Go or no-go on starting the rollout waves at the remaining sites?
agenda: Present the pilot go-live record and stability log
Discuss open issues from the pilot site
Decide whether the rollout waves start

events.label: Check-in: rollout stability
events.decision: Proceed with the remaining rollout waves as planned, or adjust them?
agenda: Present the first wave go-live and stability report
Decide whether the remaining waves proceed as planned
Align on the evidence needed for final acceptance

events.label: Final acceptance
events.purpose: Accept the ERP across all sites
events.decision: Approve the ERP as running in all 40 pharmacies and both warehouses?
agenda: Present the final acceptance pack by site
Review go-live status of each pharmacy and warehouse
Decide whether to approve the ERP as running
